title: Kung Pao Lamb Kebap
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and Turkish flavors, this spicy lamb kebap is cooked to perfection with crunchy vegetables and smoky spices.

instructions.step: 1. In a large bowl, combine lamb, unique smoky turkish spice blend, and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil. Mix well to coat lamb evenly.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add lamb to the wok or skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove lamb from wok and set aside.
4. In the same wok or skillet, add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and brown sugar. Stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
5. Add scallions and red peppers to the wok or skillet and stir-fry until vegetables are tender, about 3 minutes.
6. Add cooked lamb back to the wok or skillet and stir-fry until combined with vegetables and sauce.
7. Serve lamb kebap hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
